name: cdd-file
title: Customer due diligence file
for_each: select id, code || ' ' || name as label from customers order by code

sections.title: The customer
sections.sql: select x.code, x.name, x.kind, x.country, x.entity, x.status, x.started_on as started, x.ended_on as ended from customer_register x join customers c on c.id = x.id where x.id = $1

sections.title: Risk and CDD
sections.sql: select x.risk_rating as risk, x.cdd_level as cdd, x.pep, x.id_verified_on as verified, c.id_method as method, c.approved_by, x.approved_on, x.next_review_on as next_review from customer_register x join customers c on c.id = x.id where x.id = $1

sections.title: Source of wealth and funds
sections.sql: select coalesce(source_of_wealth, 'not recorded') as wealth, coalesce(source_of_funds, 'not recorded') as funds, sow_verified_on as verified from customers where id = $1

sections.title: Owners, controllers and trustees
sections.sql: select name, role, ownership_pct as pct, pep, id_verified_on as verified from beneficial_owners where customer_id = $1 order by role, name

sections.title: Checks on file
sections.sql: select k.kind, coalesce(b.name, 'customer') as who, k.result, k.provider, k.checked_on as checked, k.reference, k.resolution from checks k left join beneficial_owners b on b.id = k.owner_id where k.customer_id = $1 order by k.checked_on

sections.title: Matters
sections.sql: select ref, service, owner, opened_on as opened, closed_on as closed from matters where customer_id = $1 order by opened_on

sections.title: Ongoing reviews
sections.sql: select reviewed_on as reviewed, risk_rating as risk, outcome, by_whom as by from reviews where customer_id = $1 order by reviewed_on

sections.title: Open rule findings
sections.sql: select f.rule, f.severity, f.finding, f.source from compliance_findings f join customers c on c.code = f.ref where c.id = $1 order by f.rule

sections.title: Record history
sections.sql: select created_at as at, action, actor from activity where entity_id = $1::text order by created_at, id
sections.note: The file an auditor, DIA or AUSTRAC asks to see. Concerns and reports are kept out of it on purpose: they live in the compliance officer's file.

name: programme-pack
title: AML programme pack
for_each: select id, code || ' ' || name as label from entities order by code

sections.title: The firm
sections.sql: select code, name, jurisdiction, sector, supervisor, enrolment_ref, compliance_officer, co_appointed_on as appointed, co_notified_on as notified from entities where id = $1

sections.title: Programme calendar
sections.sql: select p.obligation, p.last_done, p.next_due, p.rule from programme_calendar p join entities e on e.code = p.entity where e.id = $1 order by p.next_due

sections.title: Programme history
sections.sql: select kind, done_on as done, period, reference, findings, by_whom as by from programme_events where entity_id = $1 order by done_on

sections.title: Customers by risk
sections.sql: select coalesce(x.risk_rating, 'unrated') as risk, count(*)::int as customers from customer_register x join entities e on e.code = x.entity where e.id = $1 and x.status in ('onboarding','active') group by 1 order by 1

sections.title: Staff with AML duties
sections.sql: select s.name, s.role, s.vetted_on, s.last_trained, s.training_due from staff_register s join entities e on e.code = s.entity where e.id = $1 and s.active and s.aml_role order by s.name

sections.title: Open findings
sections.sql: select f.rule, f.severity, f.ref, f.finding from compliance_findings f join entities e on e.code = f.entity where e.id = $1 order by f.severity, f.rule
sections.note: For the auditor or independent evaluator. Report counts appear in the officer report, never customer names behind a report.
